amendments.reason: the frozen pair is five seconds of a 7.0/3.0 mL/min demand, i.e. the same rule evaluated once at the reference fixture. Held fixed, a larger pump carries a smaller pump's store and the run aborts on "Oxygen capacity exceeded" as soon as supply exceeds demand

numerical.failed_run_policy: a domain exit or failed paired check is recorded with its cause and excluded from optimality claims; it is never counted as a pass, and never silently resampled
numerical.tolerance_policy: tolerances are frozen here; they are not loosened to afford more evaluations, which was tried and rejected in the M7 pilot

search.objective: minimize total auxiliary oxygen demand (mL O2/min) computed from the design and its own hydraulic work; chamber work reported alongside
search.formulation: robust constrained minimization: the design vector excludes every scenario and model-form factor, and the screens must hold across the declared cases, with the worst case reported
search.primary: boundary tracing with bisection, justified by three measured structural properties: the objective rises monotonically in cavity scale and rate, so the optimum lies on the pressure-feasibility boundary rather than inside it; coronary conductance is nearly free energetically (11.624 to 11.589 mL O2/min from 1.0 to 2.0) and only relaxes self-supply, so its optimal value is the least that satisfies the constraint; and the constraints nearly separate, since conductance and kappa move MAP by under 2 mmHg
search.monotonicity_premise: bisection assumes pressure feasibility is monotone in cavity scale at fixed rate. Observed at 80/min (0.25, 0.4 fail; 0.6, 0.8, 1.0 pass) and 150/min (0.3, 0.4 fail; 0.5 pass). The premise is declared and must be checked by evaluating points either side of every located boundary, not assumed silently
search.secondary_objective: minimum coronary conductance, traced by the epsilon-constraint method rather than folded into a weighted sum
search.verification: constrained differential evolution (scipy.optimize) in the neighbourhood of the located optimum, plus a matched-budget space-filling sample; required, not optional, since a structural argument cannot be allowed to verify itself
search.fallbacks: mesh adaptive direct search, or Bayesian optimization with a separate feasibility classifier, if the monotonicity premise fails
search.polish_reason: objective is discontinuous at domain exits and screen boundaries
search.claim: best found within the tested bounds and budget; not a global optimum

stage1.what: pressure feasibility search on the hydraulic stage

stage2.what: coupled evaluation of pressure-passing candidates across scenarios

budget.justification: staging is sound only because the pipeline is one-way; if supply-limited contraction is ever implemented the stages must be merged again

inherited_limitations: L-M4-F01 no tissue glucose buffer; substrate use is instantaneous
prescribed BIO contraction: unmet demand never reduces pumping
supply-limited contraction and full tissue buffering unimplemented
regional pressure minima, CO2/pH, injury, reperfusion and thrombosis unassessed
cavity scale is a capacity proxy, not a determined anatomical mass
amendment_policy: bump version, record what changed and why, and rerun every analysis that depended on the previous version
